title: IBN data-selling app with professional UI and WhatsApp contact link

requirements.text: Create a branded application shell named "IBN" that clearly presents the app as a professional data-selling application, including the app name in the header and page title/metadata.

quotes: i want you to build a professional DATA application for me that am going to start selling DATA and the name should be (IBN)

acceptanceCriteria: The app header/nav prominently displays the text "IBN".
Browser tab/page title includes "IBN".
Primary landing view communicates that IBN sells data (English copy).

requirements.text: Implement a clean landing page layout suitable for a data-selling business, including sections for: a short hero headline, a brief description, and a visible call-to-action to contact via WhatsApp for more details.

quotes: build a professional DATA application for me that am going to start selling DATA
together with a link that will take you into my whasapp for more detalils

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page has distinct sections (hero + description + call-to-action).
All user-facing text is in English.
The primary call-to-action is clearly visible without scrolling on common laptop screen sizes.

requirements.text: Add a WhatsApp contact link/button that opens WhatsApp chat for the phone number 09033449260.

quotes: together with a link that will take you into my whasapp for more detalils and the number is (09033449260)

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/tapping the WhatsApp button navigates to a WhatsApp chat link.
The displayed contact number is exactly "09033449260".
The WhatsApp link is available on both desktop and mobile layouts.

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, professional visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, components) across the UI suitable for a commercial data-selling brand; use a consistent design system across all screens.

quotes: i want you to designe it in a very good looking

acceptanceCriteria: UI uses a consistent color palette, typography scale, and spacing rhythm across the app.
Buttons/links/sections share consistent styling and interaction states (hover/focus).
Design avoids default/unstyled template appearance and feels intentionally branded.

requirements.text: Provide a simple "Data Plans" (or equivalent) section on the landing page that lists example data bundle offerings (static, editable in code) with name, price, and brief description.
acceptanceCriteria: A section exists that lists at least 3 example offerings with name, price, and description.
Offerings are rendered from a single in-code data structure (not hardcoded repeatedly).
No checkout/payment is required to view offerings.

requirements.text: Include a footer with basic business/contact text and a repeated WhatsApp contact link for 09033449260.

quotes: a link that will take you into my whasapp for more detalils and the number is (09033449260)

acceptanceCriteria: Footer is present on the main page.
Footer contains a WhatsApp link that works and references "09033449260".
Footer content is in English.

requirements.text: Add generated brand assets (logo and a subtle hero background/illustration) as static images and render them in the UI from the frontend public assets folder.

quotes: the name should be (IBN) and also i want you to designe it in a very good looking

acceptanceCriteria: Logo image is displayed in the header and/or hero section.
Hero background/illustration (if used) loads locally as a static asset (not via backend).
All generated images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced from there.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.

Frontend immutable paths must not be modified: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
No third-party authentication other than Internet Identity (do not add other auth providers).
Keep Motoko backend in a single main actor (do not introduce multiple backend services).
nonGoals: Implementing online payments/checkout (e.g., Stripe) unless explicitly requested later.
Implementing real-time chat or messaging inside the app.
Building an admin dashboard, inventory management, or order management unless explicitly requested later.
Integrating external databases or non-Internet-Computer hosting/deployment targets.

required: Subtle abstract tech background for a hero section (ibn-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png)
